verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a manual model selector (GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5.5) and registered RPI sub-agents for Claude Code sessions. Nothing documents HumanLayer automatically routing each task prompt to the most suitable model. Manual selection and fixed sub-agent registration are adjacent features, not automatic routing.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have each task prompt automatically routed to the most suitable underlying model
